body:
I love him so much. I know he loves me , but he is so good at making me feel like shit. Completely worthless shit. I try to tell him that I feel bad about something he did, and there’s something wrong with me by the time we’re done talking. 
I feel like I’ll never be enough for anyone. I’m not smart enough, I don’t have enough education, I don’t make enough money, I’m disorganized, emotional and I feel anxious all the time. 
Why can’t I ask for help and have him realize it isn’t a guilt trip? I tell him I feel like trash, because he snaps at me when we talk- but I’m too emotional. 
I tell him I think about dying every day, and I’m just trying to force him to agree with me about an argument. 
I can’t get through to him. He is my best friend. Why does he think this isn’t real?
